notes: 2.8.7 - The queue no longer breaks when one saved listing was damaged (for example by a lost internet connection or a restart): it shows a plain card with a Delete button and the rest of the queue still appears. New Clear live listings button removes every listing already live on eBay from the queue in one click (eBay is not touched). Also includes 2.8.6: dragging photos into the queue accepts any outside drag.
